title: 船用電力品質與保護
summary: 分開功率因數、壓降與負載波動的證據，建立配電品質模型而不提供保護整定指示。 在船舶配電與波形資料室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Separate power factor, voltage drop and fluctuating-load evidence without giving protective-device settings. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Marine distribution and waveform-data laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 三相有功與線電流：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Three-phase real power and line current: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 三相有功與線電流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Three-phase real power and line current and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船用電力品質與保護」的「三相有功與線電流」中，三相交流有功功率由線電壓、線電流與功率因數決定。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：分開功率因數、壓降與負載波動的證據，建立配電品質模型而不提供保護整定指示。
steps.instructionEn: Within Marine power quality and protection, Three-phase real power and line current examines this mechanism: Three-phase real power depends on line voltage, line current and power factor. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Separate power factor, voltage drop and fluctuating-load evidence without giving protective-device settings.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：P=100 kW，VLL=440 V，PF=0.85。關係式 I=P/(√3VLL PF)；含單位換算算式 100000/(sqrt(3)*440*0.85) = 154.37173 A。適用條件：平衡正弦穩態，不含諧波、不平衡及保護整定。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Real power 100 kW, line voltage 440 V and PF=0.85. Relation I=P/(√3VLL PF); expression including unit conversion 100000/(sqrt(3)*440*0.85) = 154.37173 A. Applicability: Balanced sinusoidal steady state; excludes harmonics, imbalance and protection settings.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：忽略功率因數會低估電流與線損。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Ignoring power factor underestimates current and conductor losses. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「三相有功與線電流」，區分有功、無功與視在功率，核對線與相的定義。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Three-phase real power and line current, Distinguish real, reactive and apparent power; verify line/phase definitions. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「船用電力品質與保護」的「三相有功與線電流：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海上能源：岸電交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Three-phase real power and line current: Mechanism and observation” in “Marine power quality and protection”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Offshore Energy: Shore-Power Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

For Feeder loop impedance, Draw the loop, check round-trip length and compare endpoint measurements. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.
